notes.title: Have some bug fixes!
notes.content: [p]Hey commando heads! Here's the very first update to the hit 2025 video game Clippy Commando. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch notes may contain spoilers for Story Mode, be warned.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is just a minor update to address some bugs and unpolished issues. This update, and probably all of the updates before 0.2.000 are just going to be fixing, polishing, and re-balancing anything that didn't get enough attention during development. So let's get into what's changed since release![/p][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][p]Additions[/p][list][*][p]Updated music credits to include all songs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "enemies digitized" stat.[/p][/*][*][p]Slimers now have an audio cue when they reform.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated crate sprites, added unique hit particles and bit sprites.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated poop sprites.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]I forgot to update some cursor logic after I finished recording footage for the trailer (oops). That's fixed now.[/p][/*][*][p]Gluer sticks no longer freeze up if unable to charge at the player (I used an underscore instead of a dash, sad).[/p][/*][*][p]Bytebourger kills are now properly tracked.[/p][list][*][p]Zip Bombers, Patchers, The Board Mother, CPU, and Overclocked CPU are no longer considered Rulerian enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All versions of Terry now have the proper palette sprite.[/p][/*][*][p]Player bullets now take into account the pierce of enemy bullets rather than instantly killing them.[/p][/*][*][p]Crates no longer have darkness hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]The player's invincibility frames no longer deplete when the game is paused (hit pause, in the level up menu, in the pause menu, etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs regarding small and medium slimers reforming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a ton of bugs with digitizing enemies:[/p][list][*][p]Digitized reanimators no longer do... that.[/p][/*][*][p]Digitized enemies no longer generate on hit objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Digitized enemies are now digitized before applying any other damage effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Reanimators no longer randomly crash the game after reanimating something.[/p][/*][*][p]Digitized enemies no longer check for wall collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Digitizing a corrector fluid bottle no longer spawns a floating bottle and now kills the brush piloting the bottle.[/p][/*][*][p]Digitized slimers now do the proper death things.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Polished the following enemy sprites:[/p][list][*][p]Staple Remover.[/p][/*][*][p]Ruler.[/p][/*][*][p]Gluer.[/p][/*][*][p]Stapler.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrector Fluid.[/p][/*][*][p]Penciler.[/p][/*][*][p]Gluer Stick.[/p][/*][*][p]Taper.[/p][/*][*][p]Slimer (all sizes).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Story Mode[/h3][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]In cutscenes, if the current speaker isn't present in the game scene, the camera will now focus on the player rather than stop moving wherever it was.[/p][/*][*][p]Defeating Terry early in Chapter 61 now causes the Clipenberg Elite Squad to spawn after 1 second.[/p][/*][*][p]"Clipenberg's Finest" achievement should now triggers properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Triggers for beating the game and unlocking floors 2 and 3 are now properly triggered.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Infinite Mode[/h3][p]Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Infinite Mode enemy spawners now have a short grace period at the beginning of the wave before spawning enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Western Ruleria now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some bushes in Western Ruleria no longer draw above the fence.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Quillshire Prison now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in The Secluded Cabin now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Inkwell Bridge now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Papyrus Prairie now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Measureton now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Measureton Sewers now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Some walls in Stationary Station Delta now have the appropriate hit particles.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Restarting an Infinite Mode run no longer softlocks the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Verified integrity of enemy spawning. Also, improved the logic a bit. That one really doesn't matter for the gameplay, that's just for the real commando heads.[/p][/*][*][p]The War Profiteer can now use floor 3 weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop dialogue now updates between waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard buttons now draw over chalk backgrounds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Clippy Commando is now available!
notes.content: [p]Hey commando heads! The hit 2025 video game Clippy Commando is now available! That's so epic and cool isn't it? [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for new updates! In the coming weeks, I plan to release bug fixes and optimization patches to address any issues that weren't found during playtesting. After that, work will begin on the first major content update :0[/p][p][/p][p] Thanks for reading this! You're the best.[/p]
